application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description: 1 x Medlar (applicants ref. T1) - Approximately 4.50m: Thin crown density evenly throughout by approximately 20%. Reduce crown by approximately 1.00m all round.  General maintenance.1 x Mature Bay (applicants ref. T2) - Approximately 9.00m: Reduce crown height by approximately 40% (3.50m-4.00m). Trim lateral and sub lateral side growth by up to approximately 1.00m.  General maintenance.Climbing Clematis and Plants (applicants ref. G1) - Cut back climber and hedge under the group of Laurels back to a more uniform height line approximately 1.20m-1.50m reduction of the hedge under the trees. Reduce back the Laurels and other small shrubs and trees which overhang the left hand boundary with No.6, to tidy and control encroachment, approximately 1.00m reduction.1 x Small Bay (applicants ref. T3) - Approximately 5.00m: Fell to ground level and treat with systemic herbicide. Control encroachment.1 x Magnolia (applicants ref. T4) - Approximately 4.00m: Fell to ground level. Tree is in decline.
